subcommittees.name: Public Lands, Forests, and Mining Subcommittee

dimensions.assessment: Directly affects the City of Ouray, Colorado, and local visitors using the federal land for recreation.
dimensions.evidence: convey to the City of Ouray, Colorado, certain land managed by the Forest Service, together with a reservoir

dimensions.assessment: Shifts ownership, maintenance responsibilities, and water rights of a specific local reservoir site to a municipal government.
dimensions.evidence: City shall agree... to assume responsibility for the costs of all repairs, operations, maintenance, replacement, rehabilitation, and regulatory compliance

dimensions.assessment: The Secretary of Agriculture pays all conveyance costs except surveys, but specific dollar amounts are not stated in the source.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary shall pay all costs associated with the conveyance under subsection (b)

dimensions.assessment: Conveys a specific federal property and associated water rights under defined terms, without creating new broad federal programs.
dimensions.evidence: convey to the City... all right, title, and interest of the United States in and to the Federal land

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent conditions on the land use, including perpetual maintenance as open space and permanent easements.
dimensions.evidence: to maintain the Federal land in perpetuity as open space

missing_information: Specific dollar amounts for conveyance costs or property valuation are not provided.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill transfers a specific 45-acre federal land parcel and associated reservoir to the City of Ouray, Colorado, affecting local administrative responsibilities, recreational access, and water rights management.
